name: 人间恶灵 Evil Spirits of the Mortal World
detailed_description:
On the evening of March 6, 1991, psychiatrist Du Wei received a mysterious phone call. Five days earlier, his friend John had visited him in a panic, claiming he was being tormented by unspeakable evil spirits. Although Du Wei provided psychological counseling and medication, he failed to recognize the true nature of the situation.

That evening, John's girlfriend called in terror, reporting that John had vanished without a trace, leaving behind only a cryptic letter. The letter directed him to an out-of-service roadside motel in the outskirts. Determined to uncover the truth, Du Wei ignored the ominous warnings and entered the eerie building alone at around 8 p.m.

Thus begins a haunting journey filled with fear and mystery…

This is a single-player narrative experience presented in third-person perspective. The game currently supports keyboard and mouse only; gamepad and online features are not supported.

Players will collect clues, interact with the environment, and explore psychological illusions as they unravel the disturbing truth behind John’s disappearance.

short_description: Evil Spirit is a third-person, single-player psychological horror exploration game. As a psychiatrist drawn into a disturbing mystery, players will investigate a friend's disappearance by exploring eerie environments, collecting clues, and confronting unsettling visions to uncover the dark truth.
